name: price-bond-checker
description: A full-stack web application that helps users track their Bangladesh Prize Bonds, automatically check draw results against uploaded official PDF documents, and get notified instantly when their bond wins, via email and in-app notifications.

paragraphs: A full-stack web application that helps users track their Bangladesh Prize Bonds, automatically check draw results against uploaded official PDF documents, and get notified instantly when their bond wins, via email and in-app notifications.

Manually cross-checking hundreds of Prize Bond numbers against draw result PDFs is tedious and error-prone. Prize Bond Checker solves this by letting users register their bonds once, and letting an admin upload the official result PDF. The system automatically parses the document, matches winning numbers against every user's bonds, updates their status, and notifies winners in real time.
features: Secure Authentication — Email/password registration with mandatory email verification before login
Bond Management — Add, view, and delete prize bonds from a personal dashboard
Personal Analytics — Visual dashboard showing total bonds, total value, win/loss/pending breakdown, and a monthly contribution chart
Real-Time Notifications — In-app notification center with unread count badge and paginated history ("See More" loads 3 at a time)
Email Alerts — Automatic congratulatory email the moment a bond is confirmed as a winner
